title: Add code generation and PR creation steps to test workflow
body:
Added `dotnet run eng/CodeGenerator.cs` before testing in `.github/workflows/test.yml` and added `peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6` step to create a PR if files change without failing when no files are modified.
